summary: Sanara MedTech filed an Item 8.01 8-K disclosing that on October 15, 2026, it and MiMedx Group each received a Federal Trade Commission Second Request for additional information and documentary materials regarding MiMedx's previously announced acquisition of Sanara via merger subsidiary Mustang Merger Sub, Inc. The Second Request extends the HSR Act waiting period until 30 days after substantial compliance, absent early termination or voluntary extension. No price, premium, or recommendation terms appear in this excerpt. The structural overhang is a prolonged antitrust review; watch FTC clearance timing and any revised outside date.
